External Affairs Minister Jaishankar Embarks on Multi-Nation Diplomatic Tour

External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar has begun a multi-nation tour, starting with visits to four Gulf countries to enhance bilateral cooperation and discuss regional developments. The tour also includes stops in the US and Belgium for talks with the EU, and will involve launching India's official campaign for a UN Security Council seat for the 2028-29 tenure. The visits aim to strengthen diplomatic ties and explore areas of mutual interest.
